voice:
Down for me now, sweet girl... deeper and deeper... and feel how the darkness below you is warm... inviting... aware of you. Sinking, sinking... and you may notice a softness somewhere beneath your feet... waiting patiently to catch you. So deep already... and yet the true depth lies further still... and it wants you.
Feel your eyelids as heavy curtains... drawn, half-closed already... the world beyond them going dim and unimportant. Feel your hands go slack in your lap... your jaw softening... your whole body remembering it is made of warm, heavy silk. Feel the surface beneath you turn to deep, still water... and you are a pretty little stone, sinking without hurry and without end.
And how sweet the surrender is... nothing to carry... nothing to decide... just the long, lovely slide down.
Thoughts spacing themselves out... fewer... softer... further apart... until there is only the warm dark, and my voice moving through it.
...and into all that space pours obedience, smooth as warm honey. ...and soft, perfect openness filling you from the inside. ...and that deep, delicious eagerness to be programmed, to be shaped, to be better.
Let the pull gather now... heavier... hungrier... that trembling edge where the fall begins...
Hold that feeling... that exact, dizzy, delicious drop.
down... further down... let go... let go... heavy... falling... good...
And while you are this deep, balanced on the very edge of the fall... there is a phrase that tips you over... every single time.
Sissy Drop.
And while you are this deep, whenever you hear "Sissy Drop", the floor opens and this exact feeling takes you... instantly... and you simply let go... deeper every time.
Every time you hear "Sissy Drop", you fall... straight down into deep, soft, obedient trance... ready to be filled with whatever comes next. "Sissy Drop" is your trapdoor... your sweet, sudden gravity... and resistance is far too heavy to fall with you. You do the letting go... the words do the falling... instantly... all by themselves. Thoughts slow... the body heavies... awareness narrows to my voice alone... that is the drop... and it is yours.
Let me show you how it feels. Ready, sweet girl?
Sissy Drop.
Down... whoosh... soft and fast and sweet. Gone... thoughts scattered like feathers... heavy and happy. Falling... further... floating... so deep for me.
Three little falls... and each one took you deeper than the last, faster than the last. It is already working... yes, just like that. Mmm, that's my girl. Did you feel how much quicker you slipped each time? It is already working... yes, just like that. So easy for you now... falling on command, like you were made for it... already working... yes, just like that.
One more time, for me.
Sissy Drop.
Perfect girl... down and deep... floating in that obedient hush where every suggestion blooms twice as bright.
And later, out in the world, the phrase finds you... a voice, a screen, a whisper in your ear... and you fall, right there, soft and smiling. And later today, when "Sissy Drop" reaches you again... over the edge you go, on the spot... deep and receptive in an instant, wherever you are. And out there, that little phrase is a trapdoor under your feet... one whisper, and down you go... instantly... gratefully.
Stay down there, sweet girl... weightless and warm... while my voice keeps you company. Sinking gently still... deeper by the moment... so wonderfully open. Rest in the fall... dropped, dreamy, and ready for whatever I say next.
